# Metric Contract Fixtures

These fixtures freeze externally visible experiment behavior before structural
refactoring.

- `metrics/three_task_metrics.json` contains hand-calculated global, seen, and
  NCM matrices. Expected values must never be regenerated by the implementation
  under test.
- `results/olora_adapted_clinc150_s0.json` is an exact semantic snapshot of
  `outputs/olora_strict_full_label_clinc150_s0/results.json`. Its canonical
  JSON SHA256 is
  `ff1647c4137d543bac11055455302f8f47e965dcf6a3ba2bd67b1d16250f15af`.
Do not update a fixture merely to make a failing refactor pass. Fixture changes
require an intentional behavior change, an explanation of that change, and a
fresh audit of every derived value.
